blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Philippine National Police (PNP) asked protest organizers on Saturday to exercise freedom of assembly in an orderly fashion ahead of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit. PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. made the reminder in light of multisectoral groups set to hold public demonstrations during the high-level meeting from Nov. 15 to 17. “May karapatan ang bawat Pilipino na magsalita at magpahayag ng kanilang saloobin. We respect that. Ang hinihiling lang natin ay maging maayos ang ating pagkilos at sundin ang mga itinakdang lugar at proseso,” Nartatez said in a statement. (Every […]...
